sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 當前合眾 Pokédex 對 #614～#643 的 34 個 ordinary／special exact forms 全部明確標示 Released: Yes；另明確列出 Dynamax Cryogonal、Dynamax Deino、Dynamax Zweilous、Dynamax Hydreigon 為 Released: Yes，並把 Mega Golurk 標為 Released: No。
現行 Shadow Pokémon 名單正面列出 Shelmet／Accelgor、Golett／Golurk、Deino／Zweilous／Hydreigon，共 7 個 ordinary exact forms；名單缺席只維持 UNKNOWN，不反推為未推出。

sources.sourceTitleOriginal: Psychic Spectacular: Taken Over Special Research
sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: Special Research 明確記錄玩家可追擊 Giovanni 並救出 Shadow Incarnate Forme Tornadus，因此只對 #641 化身形態提供直接正面推出證據，不推及靈獸形態。
活動頁明確記錄 Giovanni 擁有 Shadow Incarnate Forme Thundurus，並可由 Special Research 救出，因此只確認 #642 化身形態，不推及靈獸形態。

sources.sourceTitleOriginal: Pokémon GO Flying Taxi: Taken Over – Shadow Reshiram & New Rocket Lineups
sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 活動頁明確宣告 Shadow Reshiram 在 Flying Taxi: Taken Over 期間首次於 Pokémon GO 登場，提供 #643 Shadow 的直接正面推出證據。
官方說明 Shadow Pokémon 可使用星塵與糖果進行淨化；因此 Purified 只從同 exact form 已確認的 Shadow 狀態推導。

boundary: Every release state is exact-form scoped. All 34 ordinary/special forms are released, but ordinary release never propagates to Shadow, Purified, Mega, Dynamax, or Gigantamax. Shadow Incarnate Tornadus and Thundurus use direct form-specific event evidence so Therian forms remain UNKNOWN. Shadow roster absence remains UNKNOWN. Purified derives only from the same ten confirmed Shadow forms. Dynamax is positive only for Cryogonal and the Deino evolutionary line because the current roster lists those exact Dynamax forms. Gigantamax remains UNKNOWN. Mega Golurk is explicitly UNRELEASED without affecting ordinary Golurk. PvPoke presence never implies release.
